hero.title: Translate Peruvian Sign Language into text and voice
hero.subtitle: Bridge is an inclusive AI-powered app developed in Lima, Peru.
hero.description: We break communication barriers with cutting-edge technology that converts Peruvian Sign Language into text and voice in real-time.

about.title: Inclusion through innovation
about.subtitle: Building communication bridges
about.description: Bridge was born from the need to create a more inclusive society. Our mission is to empower the Peruvian deaf community through accessible and innovative technology.
about.missionText: Democratize communication and eliminate language barriers for the deaf community in Peru.
about.visionText: To be the leading sign language translation platform in Latin America, promoting digital inclusion.
about.valuesText: Inclusion, innovation, accessibility and social commitment guide every decision we make.

impact.title: Real impact in the community
impact.subtitle: Transforming lives through technology
impact.testimonial: Bridge has changed the way I communicate. Now I can express my ideas without barriers.
impact.communityText: We work directly with the Peruvian deaf community to ensure our technology responds to their real needs.

howItWorks.title: How Bridge works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple technology, powerful results
howItWorks.step1Description: The camera detects and captures hand movements in real-time
howItWorks.step2Description: AI analyzes gestures using models trained specifically for PSL
howItWorks.step3Description: Text and audio are generated instantly in clear and natural Spanish

team.title: Meet the team
team.subtitle: Innovators committed to inclusion
team.nirvaDescription: Software engineer passionate about creating technology that generates positive social impact.
team.michelleDescription: Developer focused on creating inclusive and user-centered experiences.
team.collaborationText: We are always looking for people passionate about inclusion and technology.

vision.title: Our vision of the future
vision.subtitle: Expanding Bridge's impact
vision.expansionText: Bring Bridge to other Latin American countries, adapting technology to different sign language variations.
vision.educationText: Develop educational tools that facilitate PSL learning for hearing people.
vision.communityText: Create a support network and resources for the deaf community throughout the region.
vision.partnership: Interested in being part of the change?
